name: calArmorAndBlock
description: Pierce/Block probability layer. Randomly determines whether attacker pierces (reduces) or defender blocks (increases) the resistance value. Used for player-type damage (att_resist, double_hit_def, counter_def, skill_resist).

parameters.attacker: Unit dealing damage (provides armor penetration stats)
parameters.attrib_key: The attribute key for the resistance (used for up_limit config lookup)

formula_steps.description: Build probability ranges for pierce and block
Calculate pierce probability (only if armor_pen > ignore_armor_pen)
Calculate block probability (only if block > ignore_block), stacked after pierce range
formula_steps.formula: if (block > ignore_block): ranges[1] = ranges[0] + roundInt(10000 * block_rate)

formula_steps.description: Roll random number and determine outcome
formula_steps.formula: rand = randomInt(0, 10000); if rand <= ranges[0]: outcome = Pierce(0); else if rand <= ranges[1]: outcome = Block(1); else: outcome = Neither(2)

formula_steps.description: Apply pierce or block to resistance

Pierce (outcome=0).note: Reduces resistance; pierce amount capped at 0.5 (50%)

Block (outcome=1).note: Increases resistance; block amount capped at 0.5 (50%)

formula_steps.description: Apply up_limit cap from attribute config
formula_steps.formula: if (config.up_limit != 0): cap = (config.num_type == 2) ? round(up_limit / 10000) : up_limit; resistance = min(resistance, cap)

notes: Pierce and block are mutually exclusive per hit — only one can trigger
The probability check uses <= comparison, so the ranges are inclusive
If armor_penetration <= ignore_armor_penetration, pierce cannot trigger (range stays 0)
If block <= ignore_block, block cannot trigger (range stays same as pierce range)
The up_limit is read from the attribute metadata config of the resistance attribute
